title: ee.write_group_commit.v1
description: Redaction-safe telemetry for group-commit write intake: counts and latencies describing how concurrent durable writes were coalesced into shared transactions and fsyncs over an observation window. Counts and timings only; never stores written content, audit bodies, or query text. See ADR 0077 (docs/adr/0077-group-commit-write-intake.md).

generatedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when the window snapshot was produced.

enabled.description: Whether group-commit intake was enabled for this window. When false, every write took the per-write fallback path.

redactionStatus.description: Redaction posture: this telemetry holds only counts and latencies.

batches.description: Number of closed commit batches in the window.

writesCoalesced.description: Number of writes that shared a batch with at least one peer.

avgBatchSize.description: Mean number of writes per closed batch.

fsyncCount.description: Number of fsyncs actually issued in the window.

fsyncSaved.description: Number of fsyncs avoided versus the per-write baseline (writes minus fsyncCount).

fallbackCount.description: Number of writes that took the per-write fallback path instead of a coalesced batch.

fallbackReasons.description: Per-reason counts of fallbacks; the keys are the closed reason set.

degraded.description: A degraded write-owner posture forced the per-write path.

oversized.description: A single write exceeded the inflight byte ceiling and committed alone.

single_writer.description: Only one writer was in flight, so no coalescing applied.
